_readme: Hand corrections for 09-build-dataset.mjs, keyed by trail id. name_en / name_ka / description_* replace the value; regenerate lists hand-written fields that are wrong and get the generated factual text instead; reject drops a new trail. Every Georgian string written here is listed in REPORT.md for review.

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000033.why: the description placed the trail in the Svaneti highlands; the route is in Borjomi municipality (Nedzvi Managed Reserve)

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000034.why: both descriptions placed the trail in Svaneti; the route is in Borjomi municipality (Nedzvi Managed Reserve)

a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000044.why: the trail is in Adjara (Kintrishi), not in Lagodekhi: OSM relation 10543228 'Yew tree and lake Tbikeli'; the Georgian name joins the OSM names 'ხე უთხოვარი' and 'ტბიყელის ტბა' (the old one said Lagodekhi and beech)
